objectives_fil: Sa fictional na kaso, sa fictional map, ituro ang hazard, pangangailangang suportahan at isang kakayahang kailangang kumpirmahin.
objectives_en: In a fictional case, on the fictional map, identify a hazard, a support need and one capacity needing confirmation.

sections.takeaway_fil: Baha sa Maligaya: may pamilyang kailangan ng tulong at hindi pa kumpirmado ang paaralan bilang silungan.
sections.takeaway_en: Flooding in Maligaya: a household needs help and the school shelter is not confirmed.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sa fictional map, ituro ang hazard, pangangailangang suportahan at isang kakayahang kailangang kumpirmahin.
sections.takeaway_en: On the fictional map, identify a hazard, a support need and one capacity needing confirmation.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ihiwalay ang panganib, pangangailangan at kakayahan; markahan ang kailangang suriin.
sections.takeaway_en: Separate hazard, need and capacity, and mark what still needs verifying.

check.prompt_fil: Sa mapa ng Maligaya, ano ang una mong gagawin?
check.prompt_en: On the Maligaya map, what do you do first?

options.fil: Markahan ang paaralan bilang silungan dahil ginamit ito noong nakaraan.
options.en: Mark the school as the shelter because it was used last time.

options.fil: Ihiwalay ang hazard, suporta at kapasidad; ipa-verify ang ruta at shelter.
options.en: Separate hazard, support need and capacity; verify route and shelter.

options.fil: Isulat sa mapa ang pangalan at bahay ng pamilya para madali silang mahanap.
options.en: Write the family's name and house on the map so responders can find them.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi pa kumpirmado ang paaralan; markahan itong "kailangang kumpirmahin" hanggang masuri. 2: Sa hiwalay na tatlong layer, kita ang alam na at ang kailangan pang suriin. 3: Pangangailangan ang nasa mapa, hindi pangalan; igalang ang privacy ng sambahayan.
check.feedback_en: 1: The school is not confirmed; mark it "verify locally" until it is checked. 2: Keeping the three layers apart shows what is known and what still needs checking. 3: The map shows the need, not the name; protect household privacy.

sections.takeaway_fil: Tatlong layer, "kailangang kumpirmahin" ang paaralan, at walang lokasyon ng residente.
sections.takeaway_en: Three layers, the school marked "verify locally", and no resident's location.

sections.takeaway_fil: Hindi opisyal na mapa o order ang mapa ng pagsasanay; igalang ang privacy ng sambahayan.
sections.takeaway_en: A practice map is not an official map or order; protect household privacy.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ipasuri muna ang mapa bago ito gamitin ng sinuman.
sections.takeaway_en: Have the map verified before anyone uses it.

check.prompt_fil: Tapos na ang mapa ng pagsasanay. Ano ang ligtas na susunod na hakbang?
check.prompt_en: The practice map is done. What is the safe next step?

options.fil: Sabihing bukas ang paaralan kahit hindi pa nasuri ng sinuman.
options.en: Say the school is open without checking with anyone.

options.fil: Ipasuri sa DRRM office at health team ang mapa bago gamitin.
options.en: Ask the DRRM office and health team to verify the map before use.

options.fil: Ipaskil ang mapa ng pagsasanay bilang opisyal na evacuation order ng barangay.
options.en: Post the practice map as the barangay's official evacuation order.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring makapinsala o maantala ang tulong: hindi pa kumpirmado ang paaralan. 2: Beripikadong mapa lang ang dapat gumabay sa tao; itala kung sino at kailan nagpatunay. 3: Hindi opisyal na hazard map o evacuation order ang mapa ng pagsasanay.
check.feedback_en: 1: This may harm or delay help: the school is still not confirmed. 2: Only a verified map should guide people; record who verified it and when. 3: The practice map is not an official hazard map or evacuation order.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ipasuri ang risk-map checklist at itala ang huling update nito.
sections.takeaway_en: Have the risk-map checklist reviewed and record its last update.
